create_training_schedule: create a TrainingSchedule with creation_time, start_time, and end_time floats to represent client training duration
create_training_schedule_from_factory: create a TrainingSchedule using TrainingScheduleFactory.create with current_time, an event generator, and num_examples
create_device_state: create a DeviceState instance with a TrainingSchedule to track a device waiting for or in training
transition_device_training_state: transition a DeviceState through training_started and training_ended to move from WAITING_FOR_START to TRAINING_FINISHED
compare_device_states: compare two DeviceState instances using less-than to prioritize devices further along in training by next_event_time
